text:
The cutest creature of the night 🐭🌙🖤 #DisneyEats #HalloweenTime
Sink your fangs into the Vampire Mickey-shaped Sourdough Bread, available at Aunt Cass Café and the Boudin Bread Cart in Disney California Adventure Park during Halloween Time at Disneyland Resort  ✨

Aunt Cass Café is located in San Fransokyo Square at Disney California Adventure Park. Enjoy freshly baked sourdough bread and delicious American and Asian-inspired dishes at this delightful café. 

The Boudin Bread Cart is also located in San Fransokyo Square at Disney California Adventure Park, near Aunt Cass Café. Stop by to take home a taste of world-famous San Francisco sourdough bread.
